catalysts.headline: Shares rose on an industry/sector review piece re-highlighting FIGS as the top performer among consumer-discretionary apparel peers on its already-reported Q2 FY2026 beat; move size reported inconsistently (5.5% to 13%) across outlets

FIGS reported Q2 2026 results: net revenue $196.6M (+28.8% YoY), ~5.6% above ~$186.1M consensus; net income $28.4M ($0.15/diluted share GAAP) vs. $0.04 YoY; adjusted EBITDA $36.6M (18.6% margin, excluding a $7.9M IEEPA tariff refund); operating margin rose to 17.9% from 6.5% YoY; raised FY2026 revenue growth guidance to ~20% (from 14–16%) and adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to 14.8–15.0%; flagged tariffs and a CBP withhold-release order against a key supplier as H2 gross-margin/inventory headwinds
catalysts.impact: Large beat and guidance raise; shares jumped roughly 25–28% on the print

catalysts.headline: Q2 FY2026 results: revenue $196.6M (+28.8% YoY, beat $186M est. by ~5.6%); EPS $0.15 vs $0.07 est.; raised FY2026 revenue-growth guidance to ~20% (from 14-16%); adjusted EBITDA margin guidance set at 14.8-15.0%; buyback authorization increased by $100M to $200M total
Added to the Russell 2000 Growth-Defensive Index and the Russell 2000 Defensive Index
